title: Official Launch of Whitedragon Dev Hub
body:

### 📢 Category: Announcements
### 📌 Title: Official Launch of Whitedragon Dev Hub

**Post Body:**

> **Date:** August 10, 2026
>
> **From:** The Whitedragon Dev Team
>
> We are pleased to officially announce the launch of **Whitedragon Dev Hub** — a dedicated community platform for members of the **whitedragon-dev** organization.
>
> This forum serves as a central space for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical discussion among our members. It is designed to foster meaningful conversations, showcase member projects, and provide a supportive environment for learning and growth.
>
> ### 🏛️ Forum Structure
>
> The forum is organized into the following categories:
>
> - **📢 Announcements** — Official updates and communications from maintainers
> - **👋 Welcome** — Introductions for new members
> - **💬 General** — Open discussion on a wide range of topics
> - **💡 Ideas** — Proposals and suggestions for new features or improvements
> - **📟 Minecraft** — Dedicated space for Minecraft-related discussions
> - **🤖 Polls** — Community voting and feedback collection
> - **⚛️ Products** — A space to share and discuss member projects
> - **🌐 Q&A** — Technical questions and peer-to-peer support
> - **🖥️ VPN & Proxies** — Discussions on privacy, freedom, and networking technologies
>
> ### 🔐 Access & Authentication
>
> Access to the forum is restricted to members of the `whitedragon-dev` GitHub organization. Authentication is handled securely via GitHub OAuth, ensuring that only verified members can participate.
>
> ### 📋 Guidelines
>
> To maintain a constructive and respectful environment, all members are expected to adhere to the following principles:
>
> 1. **Be Respectful** — Treat all members with courtesy and professionalism.
> 2. **Stay On Topic** — Post content in the appropriate categories.
> 3. **No Spam or Self-Promotion** — Product sharing is welcome in the designated category, but unsolicited advertising is not permitted.
> 4. **Help Others** — The strength of our community lies in our willingness to support one another.
>
> ### 🚀 Next Steps
>
> We encourage all members to explore the forum, introduce themselves in the **Welcome** category, and begin contributing to discussions. Your participation is what will make this community thrive.
>
> For any questions or feedback regarding the forum itself, please reach out to the maintainers via the **Ideas** category or directly on GitHub.
>
> Thank you for being part of this community. We look forward to the conversations ahead.
>
> Sincerely,
>
> **The Whitedragon Dev Team**

📢 Category: Announcements

📌 Title: Official Launch of Whitedragon Dev Hub

Post Body:

Date: August 10, 2026

From: The Whitedragon Dev Team

We are pleased to officially announce the launch of Whitedragon Dev Hub — a dedicated community platform for members of the whitedragon-dev organization.

This forum serves as a central space for collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical discussion among our members. It is designed to foster meaningful conversations, showcase member projects, and provide a supportive environment for learning and growth.

🏛️ Forum Structure

The forum is organized into the following categories:

  • 📢 Announcements — Official updates and communications from maintainers
  • 👋 Welcome — Introductions for new members
  • 💬 General — Open discussion on a wide range of topics
  • 💡 Ideas — Proposals and suggestions for new features or improvements
  • 📟 Minecraft — Dedicated space for Minecraft-related discussions
  • 🤖 Polls — Community voting and feedback collection
  • ⚛️ Products — A space to share and discuss member projects
  • 🌐 Q&A — Technical questions and peer-to-peer support
  • 🖥️ VPN & Proxies — Discussions on privacy, freedom, and networking technologies

🔐 Access & Authentication

Access to the forum is restricted to members of the whitedragon-dev GitHub organization. Authentication is handled securely via GitHub OAuth, ensuring that only verified members can participate.

📋 Guidelines

To maintain a constructive and respectful environment, all members are expected to adhere to the following principles:

  1. Be Respectful — Treat all members with courtesy and professionalism.
  2. Stay On Topic — Post content in the appropriate categories.
  3. No Spam or Self-Promotion — Product sharing is welcome in the designated category, but unsolicited advertising is not permitted.
  4. Help Others — The strength of our community lies in our willingness to support one another.

🚀 Next Steps

We encourage all members to explore the forum, introduce themselves in the Welcome category, and begin contributing to discussions. Your participation is what will make this community thrive.

For any questions or feedback regarding the forum itself, please reach out to the maintainers via the Ideas category or directly on GitHub.

Thank you for being part of this community. We look forward to the conversations ahead.

Sincerely,

The Whitedragon Dev Team
